title: Dreaming is connecting to astral realms. Also, most of my dreams take place in shopping malls
content: Soo my dreams are really vivid and realistic, may seem random (or rather fantastical) but logical, with clear messages. I also get lucid often, I've been spontanious LDs for 4 years. Soo does anybody have recurring dreams of being in malls (there are various malls that I always see in my dreams, including the one that is in my nearest city or slightly modified to ones i've never seen in real life but i have dreams in) often bizarre things happen in them, not just shopping or eating. A super common theme in my dreams is the topic of different dimensions, I've had real crazy dreams like I was being experimented on by FBI/CIA who could manipulate time and transfer me to different dimensions and the scariest part was that I was sort of getting confused and tired, I was sitting on an armchair and I thought of connecting to my 'original' dimension, closed my eyes and woke up in real life. And even after waking up, I thought which one is the real dimension? And that my previous dream could've been real. I've had detailed dreams in which I was living another live as another person, looking completely differently. Like living a double life. I won't even mention all of the things that happened to me in my dreams in this post since it's too much to write for one post and nobody will probably read it. I also wanna say that I have reccuring 'thems' /dimensions, each one of them feels differently, has a different style and I feel euphoria in them One of them, probably the most 'euphoric' one is a dimension where I am in nature/mountains, the grass is perfectly cut and bright green, there's trees, it's sunny and there are wooden houses/huts made of a specific color of wood. It feels like heaven
